title: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda to standardize parts to lower costs
why_read: A significant industry shift in auto manufacturing economics that touches supply chain and engineering standardization, relevant beyond pure software.
analysis: Three major Japanese automakers are reportedly agreeing to share and standardize parts across brands to cut costs amid rising competition, especially from EV makers. This is a business and manufacturing story rather than a software one, but it has engineering implications around platform sharing, supply chains, and cost pressure in a maturing industry. The high comment count suggests lively discussion, though the topic sits at the edge of a software engineering digest's core interest.
